items.title: 澤倫斯基：今年上半年盟友防空飛彈交付量僅去年三分之一
items.title_en: Zelensky: Allies' Air‑Defense Missile Deliveries in H1 2026 Only One‑Third of 2025
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周三（5 日）表示，盟友在 2026 年上半年向烏克蘭提供的防空飛彈數量僅為 2025 年的三分之一，而俄羅斯正尋求在冬季前大幅提高飛彈產量，這對烏克蘭構成了安全威脅。
北約（NATO）秘書長呂特表示，北約正在努力為烏克蘭提供其亟需的防空系統。歐洲首個「愛國者」飛彈生產設施預定 9 月在德國啟用。
近日烏克蘭和俄羅斯都加大對對方重要設施的打擊。澤倫斯基表示，俄羅斯周三襲擊烏克蘭首都，導致一家啤酒廠、一個倉庫和一個郵件分揀中心被摧毀，至少 17 人死亡，數十人受傷。
令人關注的是，當天烏克蘭未能攔截任何一枚俄羅斯飛彈，這可能表明烏克蘭的「愛國者」飛彈攔截器嚴重短缺，澤倫斯基希望美國可以提供更多這類彈藥，但伊朗戰爭難以結束，令這一請求成功的希望渺茫。
自烏克蘭戰爭爆發以來，烏克蘭一直缺乏美國製造的「愛國者」攔截飛彈，這種飛彈能夠攔截俄羅斯的彈道飛彈。但最近幾周，飛彈短缺問題尤為嚴重。澤倫斯基說，攔截飛彈短缺的主要原因是中東戰爭。
伊朗戰爭消耗了大量「愛國者」飛彈和其他攔截飛彈，攔截飛彈短缺問題變得更加嚴峻。一項分析估計，自伊朗戰爭開打以來，美國的「愛國者」飛彈庫存至少銳減 65%。
知情人士本周透露，美國軍方已耗盡關鍵飛彈防禦系統近 80% 攔截彈，五角大廈的彈藥儲備已降至危險低點，美軍在衝突中幾乎動用了所有高精度遠程地對空武器。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Wednesday (the 5th) that the number of air‑defence missiles allies will deliver to Ukraine in the first half of 2026 is only one‑third of what they supplied in the same period of 2025, while Russia is seeking to dramatically boost its missile production before winter, posing a security threat to Ukraine.

NATO Secretary‑General Jens Stoltenberg said the alliance is working hard to provide Ukraine with the air‑defence systems it urgently needs. Europe’s first Patriot missile production facility is slated to become operational in Germany in September.

In recent days both Ukraine and Russia have stepped up strikes on each other’s critical infrastructure. Zelensky said Russia attacked the Ukrainian capital on Wednesday, destroying a brewery, a warehouse and a mail‑sorting centre, killing at least 17 people and wounding dozens.

Of particular concern, Ukraine failed to intercept any Russian missile that day, suggesting a severe shortage of Patriot interceptors. Zelensky hopes the United States can supply more of these munitions, but the ongoing war in Iran makes the prospect of success dim.

Since the war began, Ukraine has lacked U.S.-made Patriot interceptors, which are capable of shooting down Russian ballistic missiles. In recent weeks the shortage has become acute, and Zelensky blamed the scarcity primarily on the Middle‑East war.

The war in Iran has consumed large numbers of Patriot and other interceptors, worsening the shortage. An analysis estimates that since the conflict started, U.S. Patriot missile stockpiles have been reduced by at least 65%.

Sources familiar with the matter said this week that the U.S. military has exhausted nearly 80% of the interceptors for its key missile‑defence systems, with Pentagon ammunition reserves falling to a dangerously low level, and the U.S. has nearly deployed all of its high‑precision long‑range ground‑to‑air weapons in the conflict.

items.title: 中國迎「最貴裝機季」高階筆電接近5萬元大關
items.title_en: China Faces “Most Expensive Upgrade Season” as High-End Laptops Near the 50,000‑Yuan Mark
paras: 原本屬於大學生「開學煥新」和職場人升級裝備的中國暑期旺季，今年卻演變為不少消費者口中「最貴裝機季」。
在中國主流銷售渠道，人民幣（下同）4,000 元以下的平價機型已經越來越少，普通用戶更換電腦的門檻顯著抬升。即便算上各類補貼和優惠，高階筆電到手價也普遍突破萬元（新台幣 47,751 元）大關。
據《科創板日報》周四（6 日）報導，多位業界人士表示，2026 年 PC 產品平均銷售價格（ASP）預計將實現兩位數以上年增長，而來自上游供應鏈的成本壓力至少會持續到 2026 年年底。
業界人士說，從記憶體、GPU 到驅動 IC、電源管理晶片等，PC 產業鏈各環節已普遍釋出價格調漲信號，終端漲價已成不可逆之勢。
「今年 2 月花 5,000 元買的輕薄筆電，現在同款都快 8,000 元了，早知道直接加錢上電競筆電。」江蘇一位消費者感嘆。某河南消費者也說，2025 年某品牌高階電競筆電售價尚在 9,000 元檔，如今同型號已飆漲到 1.5 萬元。
Counterpoint Research 高級分析師 Minsoo Kang 表示，當前受記憶體等關鍵組件成本上漲影響，PC 市場承受強勁漲價壓力。入門級產品原本利潤率已處於歷史低點，面對物料清單（BOM）成本持續抬升，其商業可持續性正面臨威脅。
高階市場同樣難以規避成本壓力，由於硬體配置更高，組件成本上漲迫使產品大幅漲價，消費者對價格的承受能力面臨考驗。
多名分析師說，今年以來高階 PC 的漲幅更大。CIC 灼識董事總經理陳一心提到，此輪漲價為 PC 全行業普漲，但並非等幅上行。高階電競筆電和專業級行動工作站的漲幅顯著，普通文書筆電的漲幅相對溫和。
IDC 中國高級研究經理陳舒歆也認為，今年以來中國 PC 市場整體價格呈現明顯上行趨勢，尤其是高階文書筆電和電競筆電的漲幅較大。
某筆電品牌經銷商向透露，近期 4,000 元至 5,000 元價位的中低階機型漲幅也非常明顯，普遍上漲兩三千元；萬元級高階筆電的漲幅則控制在千元左右。
「高階產品利潤空間較厚，廠家在定價上留有餘地。」該經銷商判斷，今年筆電價格仍可能繼續走高，記憶體、硬碟、CPU 等核心部件成本均持續攀升。
paras_en: What used to be a summer peak for college students refreshing their gear and professionals upgrading equipment has turned this year into what many consumers call the “most expensive upgrade season” in China.

On mainstream sales channels in China, affordable models priced under RMB 4,000 are becoming increasingly scarce, raising the barrier for ordinary users to replace their computers. Even after accounting for various subsidies and promotions, the net price of high‑end laptops generally exceeds the RMB 10,000 (NT$47,751) threshold.

According to the Science and Innovation Board Daily on Thursday (the 6th), several industry insiders said the average selling price (ASP) of PC products is expected to post double‑digit annual growth in 2026, and cost pressures from upstream suppliers will likely persist at least until the end of 2026.

Industry sources noted that price‑increase signals have been released across the PC supply chain—from memory and GPUs to driver ICs and power‑management chips—making end‑user price hikes an irreversible trend.

“I bought a thin‑and‑light laptop for RMB 5,000 in February, and the same model now costs almost RMB 8,000. Had I known, I would have just paid more for a gaming laptop,” lamented a consumer from Jiangsu. A consumer in Henan added that a high‑end gaming laptop of a certain brand was priced around RMB 9,000 in 2025, but the same model now soars to RMB 15,000.

Minsoo Kang, senior analyst at Counterpoint Research, said the PC market is under strong price‑inflation pressure due to rising costs of key components such as memory. Entry‑level products were already operating at historically low profit margins, and the continual rise in bill‑of‑materials (BOM) costs threatens their commercial viability.

The high‑end segment is equally unable to dodge cost pressures; because the hardware configurations are more advanced, component cost hikes force a substantial price increase, testing consumers’ willingness to pay.

Several analysts said the price rise for high‑end PCs has been even larger this year. Chen Yixin, managing director of CIC Insight, noted that this round of price hikes is a broad‑based increase across the PC industry, but not uniform. High‑end gaming laptops and professional mobile workstations have seen pronounced jumps, while ordinary office laptops have risen more modestly.
Chen Shuxi, senior research manager for IDC China, also observed that overall PC prices in China have shown a clear upward trend this year, especially for high‑end office laptops and gaming laptops.

A dealer for a laptop brand disclosed that recent price hikes for mid‑range models in the RMB 4,000‑5,000 range are also noticeable, typically rising by two to three thousand yuan, while the increase for ten‑thousand‑yuan high‑end laptops is kept to around a thousand yuan.

“High‑end products have thicker profit margins, giving manufacturers room to set prices,” the dealer judged, adding that laptop prices may continue to climb this year as core components such as memory, SSDs and CPUs keep rising in cost.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台橡上半年獲利創近5年新高 股價跳空鎖漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Taiwan Rubber Posts Record Profit in First Half, Shares Surge
paras: 橡膠股台橡 (2103-TW) 受惠中國新廠量產、原料成本壓力減輕及產品報價調漲、毛利提升，上半年稅後純益 18.67 億元、年增 613%，創近 5 年新高，EPS 達 2.26 元，受財報亮眼激勵，台橡今 (7) 日開盤直接跳空漲停來到 25 元，在外資連 3 買與主力偏多支援下，出現補漲與業績行情。
台橡今年上半年營業毛利率為 17.01％、年增 7 個百分點；營益率 11.09％、年增 8.33 個百分點，受惠於中國新廠量產，加上綠色輪胎等高值化產品出貨增加，今日出現短線追價力道。
法人指出，上半年因中東情勢緊張，在伊朗封鎖荷莫茲海峽後，一度推升油價大幅上漲，也帶動丁二烯價格持續攀升，使得合成橡膠生產成本快速墊高，報價機制由季報價調整為「月報價」，讓業者也調整報價反映成本上揚，加上物流成本增加，也推升台橡的獲利空間。
台橡產品包括 SBR、BR、SIS 等，應用於輪胎、鞋材、醫療及工業材料，其中輪胎用橡膠仍是最大營收來源，近年公司積極提高高值化產品比重，例如高性能輪胎及醫療材料力拼轉型空間。
paras_en: Taiwan Rubber (2103-TW) benefited from China's new factory production, reduced raw material costs, and increased product prices, resulting in a net profit of NT$18.67 billion in the first half, up 613% year-over-year, a new high in nearly five years. Earnings per share (EPS) reached NT$2.26. The company's impressive earnings report prompted Taiwan Rubber to jump 25% to NT$25 at the opening on July 7, with foreign investors buying for the third consecutive day and institutional investors supporting the stock, leading to a surge in price and a strong earnings trend.

Taiwan Rubber's operating margin in the first half was 17.01%, up 7 percentage points year-over-year, while its operating profit margin was 11.09%, up 8.33 percentage points year-over-year. The company benefited from China's new factory production and increased sales of high-value products such as green tires, leading to a short-term buying trend.

A company insider pointed out that the Middle East situation was tense in the first half, with Iran blocking the Hormuz Strait, causing oil prices to surge significantly, and propylene prices to continue rising, resulting in a rapid increase in the production costs of synthetic rubber. The company adjusted its pricing mechanism from quarterly to monthly, allowing it to reflect the increase in costs. Additionally, increased logistics costs also boosted Taiwan Rubber's profit space.

Taiwan Rubber's products include SBR, BR, SIS, and others, which are used in tires, footwear, medical, and industrial materials. Tire rubber remains the largest revenue source, and the company has been actively increasing the proportion of high-value products in recent years, such as high-performance tires and medical materials, to transform and expand its business space.

items.title: 攻銀髮商機！台新新光金秀AI防詐與健康生態圈 林維俊樂觀看下半年景氣
items.title_en: Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. Sees Opportunities in the Aging Population
paras: 台灣正式邁入超高齡社會，台新新光金控 (2887-TW) 今 (7) 日起至 9 日，於「2026 高齡健康產業博覽會」盛大參展，總經理林維俊受訪時指出，隨著金管會日前核准銀行合併，集團未來將朝規模更大、業務更均衡的方向發展，透過整合銀行、保險、證券及投信的完整平台，提供一站式高齡整合方案。對於近期熱議的四貸同堂，他強調，台新銀向來秉持謹慎、保守的授信原則，未來也會維持嚴格的風險控管態度，他同時對台灣下半年的經濟展望抱持高度樂觀。
面對高齡市場的龐大潛力，林維俊表示，過去金融業多提供單一產品，但進入高齡社會後，民眾需要的是從預防醫療、健康管理到退休規劃、資產傳承的完整解決方案。台新新光金控的優勢在於以人為本的企業文化與完整的金融版圖，能陪伴客戶走過人生不同階段。

針對高齡族群最關注的金融詐騙問題，林維俊強調集團已全面導入 AI 防詐機制與高齡友善措施。台新銀行現場展示了「台新戰神模型」，能全天候透過 AI 分析異常交易與可疑行為，即時示警以阻斷詐騙；新光人壽則針對高齡保戶推出「家族聯絡網服務」，提供 60 歲以上長者預先設定「可信任聯絡人」，一旦發現疑似保單異常，便會主動聯繫共同確認，聯手築起資產安全防線。此外，台新銀行亦提供信託架構互動牆，推廣「預立信託」與「跨代傳承」觀念。
談及下半年金融市場展望，林維俊抱持樂觀看法。他觀察指出，目前資本市場活絡、金融業放款持續成長，顯示整體經濟活動熱度不減，且景氣並未偏離正常軌道，一切均在可控範圍內。
隨著台股交投熱絡，外界開始關注「四貸同堂」議題，憂心部分民眾擴大槓桿投入股市衍生風險。對此，林維俊重申，台新新光金控一直以來都秉持非常謹慎、保守的授信原則，未來也會持續維持一貫嚴格的風險控管態度。
2026 高齡健康產業博覽會於世貿一館展出，民眾參與攤位互動不僅能體驗各項 AI 創新服務，還有機會抽中價值萬元的基因檢測方案等多項大禮。台新新光金控期望透過科技與金融的結合，為國人長壽人生超前部署，精準守護幸福資產。

本次博覽會中，台新新光金控以「聰明理財存健康，AI 守護享樂活」為主題，整合旗下子公司資源。台新銀行 Richart Life 攜手新光人壽推出「Go 健康 GoFit」專區，首創健康分級回饋機制，鼓勵民眾養成健康習慣賺取點數；新光人壽則開創「重大傷病險 × 基因檢測自由選」生態圈，推出「溢卡安心」重大傷病險，並結合嘉和健康集團的高端 DNA 解碼技術，達到早預防的效果。此外，為補足長者退休資金，新光人壽同步推出「安心退休有保障平台」，協助規劃第三筆退休金；台新證券也透過「好富投 APP」提供智慧選股與防詐提醒，陪伴投資人穩健布局。
paras_en: Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. (2887-TW) officially entered the super-aged society in Taiwan, and today (7) to 9, participated in the "2026 Aging Health Industry Expo". General Manager Lin Wei-jun stated that, following the recent approval by the Financial Supervisory Commission, the group will develop in the direction of larger scale and more balanced business, providing a one-stop aging integration solution through the integration of banks, insurance, securities, and investment trust platforms. Regarding the recent hot topic of four loans together, he emphasized that Chinatrust Bank has always adhered to a cautious and conservative lending principle, and will continue to maintain a strict risk management attitude in the future. He also expressed a high degree of optimism about Taiwan's economic prospects in the second half of the year.

Facing the huge potential of the aging market, Lin Wei-jun stated that, in the past, the financial industry has provided single products, but after entering the aging society, people need a comprehensive solution from preventive medicine, health management, retirement planning, and asset inheritance. Chinatrust Financial Holding Co.'s advantage lies in its people-centered corporate culture and complete financial map, which can accompany customers through different stages of life.

Regarding the financial fraud problem that is most concerned by the aging population, Lin Wei-jun emphasized that the group has fully introduced AI anti-fraud mechanisms and aging-friendly measures. Chinatrust Bank has showcased the "Chinatrust War God Model" at the scene, which can analyze abnormal transactions and suspicious behavior through AI analysis 24/7, and immediately alert to prevent fraud. New Fubon Life has launched the "Family Contact Network Service" for high-age policyholders, providing a pre-set "trusted contact person" for those over 60, and if suspicious policy anomalies are found, it will actively contact and confirm together to build a secure asset defense line. In addition, Chinatrust Bank also provides a trust framework interactive wall to promote the concept of "pre-established trusts" and "cross-generation inheritance".

Regarding the economic prospects of the second half of the year, Lin Wei-jun expressed a positive outlook. He observed that the capital market is currently active, and financial institutions continue to grow lending, indicating that overall economic activity remains hot, and the economy has not deviated from the normal track, and everything is within controllable limits.

As the stock market is hot, the outside world has begun to pay attention to the "four loans together" issue, worrying that some people will expand their leverage and invest in stock market derivatives risks. In response, Lin Wei-jun reiterated that Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. has always adhered to a very cautious and conservative lending principle, and will continue to maintain a strict risk management attitude in the future.

The 2026 Aging Health Industry Expo is being held at the World Trade Center, and visitors can not only experience various AI innovative services, but also have the opportunity to win a genetic testing scheme worth one million yuan and other major gifts. Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. hopes to use technology and finance to pre-deploy a long and healthy life for the people, and accurately protect their assets.

At this expo, Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. has taken "Smart Finance, Healthy Life, AI Protection, Enjoyment, and Happiness" as the theme, integrating the resources of its subsidiary companies. Chinatrust Bank's Richart Life has partnered with New Fubon Life to launch the "Go Healthy GoFit" zone, creating a health level return mechanism for the first time, encouraging people to develop healthy habits and earn points; New Fubon Life has created a "Major Injury Insurance x Genetic Testing Free Choice" ecosystem, launching the "Surplus Card Anxiang" major injury insurance, and combining the high-end DNA decoding technology of Jiahe Health Group to achieve early prevention. In addition, to supplement the retirement funds of the elderly, New Fubon Life has simultaneously launched the "Anxiang Retirement Security Platform" to help plan the third retirement pension; Chinatrust Securities has also used the "Good Rich Investment APP" to provide intelligent stock selection and anti-fraud reminders, accompanying investors to make stable layouts.

items.title: 荷姆茲局勢與央行狂買助攻！瑞銀CIO看好金價明年6月挑戰5200
items.title_en: Hormuz Situation and Central Bank Buying Boost Gold! SocGen CIO Sees Gold Price Challenge 5200 in June
paras: 地緣政治情勢出現轉機，加上多重宏觀經濟因素催化，今 (7) 日國際金價展現強勁反彈力道。繼前一日大漲 4.2% 後，金價於亞洲早盤一度衝上每盎司 4,304 美元，刷新 7 周以來新高。瑞銀 CIO 看好金價明年 6 月底的目標價上看每盎司 5,200 美元，主要原因在於市場對荷姆茲海峽重開的預期顯著增強，美國總統川普表示已與伊朗重啟談判，雖然協議尚未正式達成，但海峽某種程度上已開放，談判整體進展良好。
瑞銀 CIO 指出，除了地緣局勢放緩外，中國買盤興趣、交易所交易基金（ETF）資金持續淨流入、利率環境趨於寬鬆，以及市場重新聚焦儲備多元化等因素，皆為金價提供強勁支撐。同時，美日政府先前為穩定日圓採取的聯合措施，有效避免美國國債遭遇拋售潮，亦對金價形成實質支撐。
瑞銀 CIO 指出，金價的最新走勢進一步印證先前的判斷，在宏觀經濟、資金流向以及投資組合多元化需求等多重因素共同作用下，黃金仍有望獲得堅實支撐。考慮到美國債券收益率可能趨於下行、美元預期進一步走弱，加上各國央行持續購金，瑞銀 CIO 繼續預計金價有望在明年上半年突破 5,000 美元，到明年 6 月底的目標價上看每盎司 5,200 美元。
有鑑於此，瑞銀 CIO 繼續認為，在多元化程度較高的投資組合中，配置中個位數比例（約 4% 至 6%）的黃金是適宜的策略；同時，瑞銀 CIO 也建議投資者可考慮配置廣泛的大宗商品敞口，以進一步增強投資組合的抗風險能力與多元化水準。

從國際金市觀察，市場法人亦普遍看好黃金長線走勢。Gabelli 黃金基金經理人 Mancini 表示，政府債務持續攀升、各國央行分散美元資產、去美元化趨勢及地緣政治不確定性，將持續支撐黃金的長期多頭格局，金價有望重返 5,000 美元關卡。儘管油價上漲可能推升通膨並促使聯準會再度升息，進而造成金價短線波動，但不致扭轉長線趨勢。此外，大型金礦商獲利及現金流強勁，目前評價仍偏低，若金價維持高檔，金礦股的上漲潛力可能優於實體黃金。
另據臺灣銀行國際金市日報資料，世界黃金協會指出，全球央行 6 月淨買進 51 公噸黃金，烏茲別克、哈薩克、中國等國持續增持。累計上半年，波蘭買進 82 公噸居冠，烏茲別克 41 公噸、中國 40 公噸及哈薩克 27 公噸緊追在後。
在 ETF 資金流向方面，全球 17 檔主要黃金 ETF 於 2026 年 8 月 5 日持有量單日增加 3.626 噸，總量達 3,010.50 公噸；全球最大的 SPDR 黃金 ETF 於 8 月 6 日持股亦增加 0.571 公噸至 1,014.72 公噸，顯示機構與散戶資金均在持續流入金市。
paras_en: The geopolitical situation has taken a turn for the better, coupled with multiple macroeconomic factors, international gold prices have shown a strong rebound force today. Following a 4.2% surge the previous day, gold prices in Asia rose to $4,304 an ounce at one point, setting a new high in seven weeks. SocGen's CIO is optimistic about the gold price target of $5,200 an ounce by the end of June next year, mainly due to the significant increase in market expectations for the Hormuz Strait to reopen, US President Trump has stated that he has restarted talks with Iran, although the agreement has not been formally reached, the strait has been opened to some extent, and the overall progress of the talks has been good.

SocGen's CIO pointed out that, in addition to the easing of geopolitical tensions, China's buying interest, continuous net inflows of exchange-traded fund (ETF) funds, a relatively loose interest rate environment, and the market's renewed focus on reserve diversification, all provide strong support for the gold price. At the same time, the joint measures taken by the US and Japanese governments to stabilize the yen have effectively prevented the sale of US bonds, which has also provided substantial support for the gold price.

SocGen's CIO pointed out that the latest trend of gold prices has further confirmed the previous judgment, under the joint action of multiple factors such as macroeconomic conditions, capital flows, and investment portfolio diversification needs, gold is still expected to have solid support. Considering that US Treasury yields may trend downward, the dollar is expected to weaken further, and central banks continue to buy gold, SocGen's CIO continues to predict that the gold price is expected to break through $5,000 an ounce in the first half of next year and reach the target price of $5,200 an ounce by the end of June next year.

As a result, SocGen's CIO continues to believe that allocating a middle-digit percentage (approximately 4% to 6%) of gold in a diversified investment portfolio is a suitable strategy; at the same time, SocGen's CIO also recommends that investors consider allocating a broad commodity exposure to further enhance the risk resistance and diversification of their investment portfolios.

From the international gold market, market professionals also generally look favorably on the long-term trend of gold. Gabelli Gold Fund Manager Mancini said that the continuous rise in government debt, the diversification of central banks' US dollar assets, the trend of de-dollarization, and geopolitical uncertainty will continue to support the long-term bullish trend of gold, and the gold price is expected to return to the $5,000 an ounce level. Although rising oil prices may push up inflation and prompt the Fed to raise interest rates again, causing gold prices to fluctuate in the short term, it will not reverse the long-term trend. In addition, large gold mining companies have strong profits and cash flows, and their valuation is still relatively low, if the gold price remains high, the potential for gold mining stocks to rise may be greater than that of physical gold.

According to data from the Taiwan Bank International Gold Market Daily Report, the World Gold Council pointed out that global central banks bought a net 51 tonnes of gold in June, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, and China continued to increase their holdings. Cumulatively in the first half of the year, Poland bought 82 tonnes, Uzbekistan 41 tonnes, China 40 tonnes, and Kazakhstan 27 tonnes followed closely behind.

In terms of ETF capital flows, the global 17 major gold ETFs held a total of 3,010.50 tonnes on August 5, 2026, an increase of 3.626 tonnes from the previous day; the largest SPDR Gold ETF on August 6 also increased its holdings by 0.571 tonnes to 1,014.72 tonnes, showing that institutional and retail capital are continuing to flow into the gold market.

items.title: 英飛凌攜手聯發科 卡位車規NOR Flash缺貨商機
items.title_en: Micron Partners with Mediatek to Capture NOR Flash Opportunity in Automotive
paras: 英飛凌今 (7) 日宣布與聯發科 (2454-TW) 合作，為未來車輛打造先進、AI 驅動的汽車座艙體驗。英飛凌車規級 NOR Flash 已完成在 Dimensity Auto Cockpit 平台 C-X1 上的認證，為車廠、Tier-1 供應商，以及開發下一代智慧座艙系統的設計合作夥伴提供通過認證且易於採用的記憶體選項。

英飛凌記憶體解決方案部門資深副總裁 Rainer Hoehler 表示，車用記憶體實現創新的關鍵推手，因為軟體定義車輛仰賴高效能系統單晶片 (SoCs)、日益複雜的韌體，以及大量資料儲存。前瞻的數位座艙與 OTA(無線軟體更新) 能力正驅動對更高容量 NOR Flash 的需求。通過聯發科認證後，客戶將可更輕鬆地採用英飛凌 512 Mb NOR Flash ，打造面向未來的智慧座艙記憶體解決方案。
聯發科副總兼汽車業務總經理張豫臺表示，英飛凌車規級 NOR Flash 提供公司高階旗艦級的 Dimensity Auto Cockpit 平台 C-X1 更高的效能、可靠性與功能安全。其高容量設計可支援下一代軟體定義汽車 (SDV) 中不可或缺的先進 AI 與使用者體驗功能。在雙方長期合作的基礎上，我們善用英飛凌在產業中的領先優勢，為持續演進的軟體定義生態系提供可靠的關鍵基礎。

英飛凌 512 Mb QSPI NOR Flash 記憶體可儲存韌體與開機程式碼，以支援 SoC 層級的 AI 驅動功能，例如語音助理、駕駛監控、行車旅拍 (vlog) 生成、環境感知，以及個人化影音推薦。該解決方案支援功能安全且加密的開機 (safe and security boot) ，亦提供關鍵備援功能以提升安全性。這款產品採用英飛凌 MirrorBit 技術，具備強固的介面、可與主流車用 SoC 廣泛相容、通過 AEC‑Q100 認證，並支援最高 +125°C 的工作溫度。
paras_en: Micron today announced a collaboration with Mediatek (2454-TW) to create advanced, AI-driven in-vehicle experiences for future vehicles. Micron's automotive-grade NOR Flash has completed certification on the Dimensity Auto Cockpit platform C-X1, providing a certified and adoptable memory option for OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and design partners developing next-generation intelligent cockpit systems.

Rainer Hoehler, senior vice president of Micron's memory solutions business, stated that automotive memory is a key enabler of innovation, as software-defined vehicles rely on high-performance system-on-chip (SoCs), increasingly complex firmware, and large data storage. Forward-looking digital cockpits and over-the-air (OTA) capabilities are driving demand for higher-capacity NOR Flash. Following Mediatek's certification, customers can more easily adopt Micron's 512 Mb NOR Flash to create forward-looking intelligent cockpit memory solutions.

Mediatek's vice president and automotive business general manager, Zhang Yu Tai, stated that Micron's automotive-grade NOR Flash provides the company's high-end flagship Dimensity Auto Cockpit platform C-X1 with higher performance, reliability, and functional safety. Its high-capacity design can support the advanced AI and user experience functions essential to next-generation software-defined vehicles (SDV). Building on their long-term collaboration, we leverage Micron's industry-leading advantages to provide a reliable foundation for the continuously evolving software-defined ecosystem.

Micron's 512 Mb QSPI NOR Flash memory can store firmware and boot code to support SoC-level AI-driven functions, such as voice assistants, driver monitoring, in-vehicle video generation (vlog), environmental perception, and personalized audio recommendations. The solution supports secure and encrypted boot (safe and security boot) and provides critical redundancy functions to enhance security. This product uses Micron's MirrorBit technology, featuring a robust interface, wide compatibility with mainstream automotive SoCs, AEC-Q100 certification, and support for up to +125°C operating temperatures.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro漲價+缺貨雙重夾擊！A20 Pro良率高卻卡在DRAM 華爾街：新機1399美元起跳
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Faces Double Whammy: Price Hike and Shortage
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，距離 iPhone 18 系列發表倒數幾周，蘋果新機正面臨「成本暴衝＋DRAM 斷料」雙重夾擊，漲價幾成定局，首發缺貨亦難避免。
美國科技媒體《9to5mac》引述供應鏈與機構測算指出，漲價底氣來自三項硬體成本。一是全球 DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體持續緊缺、記憶體現貨價格暴漲；二是全新可變光圈主鏡頭成本較上一代增加 50%；三是首發台積電 2 奈米 A20 Pro 晶片搭配 WMCM 封裝，先進製程費用大幅墊高。
根據華爾街測算，為守住基本毛利，新機最低定價需 1299 美元，若計入影像溢價，蘋果很可能把 Pro 起售價鎖在 1399 美元，較此前同款漲價 300 美元；Pro Max 同步上調。
《彭博資訊》此前報導亦稱 Pro 漲幅介於 100 至 200 美元，僅摩根大通認為可透過零件優化對沖部分壓力。以 1299 美元試算，機型毛利率將從上代 47% 降至 44%，支撐 1399 美元站位。
產能端更棘手。A20 Pro 晶圓良率穩定、台積電產線正常，但專用 DRAM 供貨缺口巨大，已產出晶片無法完成 WMCM 整合封裝，台積電超 10 億美元等級的蘋果處理器產能被迫空轉。
供應鏈預判，iPhone 18 首發初期能保基礎鋪貨，但線上等待期拉長、線下門市現貨快速見底。
雪上加霜的是產品線收縮：今秋取消標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone Air 2(延至 2027 初)，僅留 iPhone Ultra 與 18 Pro 系列，入門款需求全數灌向 Pro，供需矛盾被進一步放大。
對消費者而言，新一代 Pro 不是「買不買得起」的單選，而是「付 1399 美元還要等多久」的雙重考驗。
對蘋果來說，DRAM 漲價潮正把硬體定價權從品牌溢價，部分交還給記憶體廠。
paras_en: A few weeks before the release of the iPhone 18 series, Apple's new machine is facing a double whammy of 'cost explosion + DRAM shortage', with a price hike almost certain and initial shortages unavoidable.

According to a report by US tech media 9to5mac, citing supply chain and institutional estimates, the price hike is driven by three hardware costs. Firstly, the global shortage of DRAM and NAND flash memory has led to a sharp increase in memory prices. Secondly, the new variable aperture main camera costs 50% more than the previous generation. Thirdly, the use of TSMC's 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip with WMCM packaging has significantly increased the cost of the advanced process.

According to Wall Street estimates, to maintain a basic profit margin, the new machine's minimum price would need to be $1,299. If image premium is factored in, Apple is likely to set the Pro starting price at $1,399, a $300 increase from the previous generation, with Pro Max following suit.

A previous report by Bloomberg Information also estimated that the Pro price hike would be between $100 and $200. However, Morgan Stanley believes that component optimization could help offset some of the pressure. At $1,299, the machine's profit margin would drop from 47% to 44%, supporting a $1,399 price point.

The production end is even more complicated. The A20 Pro chip has a stable yield rate, and TSMC's production lines are normal, but the shortage of specialized DRAM is massive. The produced chips cannot be completed with WMCM integration packaging, and TSMC's Apple processor production capacity has been forced to idle, with losses exceeding $1 billion.

Supply chain predictions indicate that the initial shipment of iPhone 18 will be able to meet basic demand, but online waiting periods will be extended, and offline store inventory will quickly dwindle.

Adding to the woes is the product line contraction: the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 (delayed to early 2027) will be canceled, leaving only the iPhone Ultra and 18 Pro series. The entry-level demand will be fully shifted to Pro, further exacerbating the supply-demand contradiction.
For consumers, the new Pro series is not a 'can't afford it' option, but a 'can I afford it and wait for how long' double test.
For Apple, the DRAM price surge is taking away the company's hardware pricing power, partly returning it to memory manufacturers.

items.title: LG會長下周赴美會見黃仁勳 擴大實體AI、機器人等合作
paras: 《韓聯社》引述消息人士報導，LG 集團會長具光謨將於下週在美國會晤輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳，推進雙方在人工智慧基礎設施以及機器人領域的合作。
此次重逢距黃仁勳今年 6 月初訪韓、在首爾永登浦區 LG 雙子塔與具本茂會面約兩個月。雙方將探討擴大在實體人工智慧（AI）和人工智慧資料中心領域合作的相關方式，這也是兩家公司近期一直在推進的合作方向。消息人士表示，雙方預計討論潛在投資規模以及技術開發時間表。
早在 6 月 8 日雙方會面時，黃仁勳便表示，輝達將與 LG 集團在人形機器人與下一代資料中心領域展開合作。當時具光謨稱，受時間限制，雙方未能展開深入磋商；黃仁勳隨後邀請他前往加州進行後續洽談。
目前 LG 已與輝達建立多項合作關係，並在三大人工智慧核心領域展開合作：物理人工智慧、人工智慧資料中心以及移動出行領域。
雙方採用輝達的物理人工智慧平台「IsaacGR00T」聯合研發機器人，同時推動資料中心冷卻解決方案的升級，包括冷卻液分配單元（中央處理器），以及移動出行人工智慧系統，涵蓋自動駕駛技術。

items.title: 歷年規模最大文博會！「台灣專利超級站」首次進駐 7天免費諮詢不斷電
items.title_en: Largest Ever Taiwan Cultural and Creative Expo! "Taiwan Patent Super Station" Debuts with 7 Days of Free Consultations
paras: 經濟部智慧財產局「台灣專利超級站（Taiwan Patent GO）」於 8 月 6 日至 12 日進駐 2026 台灣文化創意博覽會。智慧局表示，今年首度於文博會設置「台灣專利超級站」，不僅開創智財專業服務深入國家級文創盛會的全新指標，更展現政府積極結合文化創意與智慧財產保護的決心。展期中透過免費智慧財產諮詢服務及專題講座，協助具原創內容、文化特色或設計價值的品牌與創作者掌握智慧財產保護機制，進一步提升創新成果的保護能力與市場競爭力。
智慧局提到，今年的台灣文博會創下歷年規模最大、展期最長紀錄，並以「# 第零位元」為年度主題，在人工智慧快速發展的時代背景下，引領觀者重新思考人類創造力的本質與價值。智慧局在文博會設立「台灣專利超級站」，指標性地將專利、商標與著作權防護網延伸至文創產業最前線，向廣大創作者推廣智慧財產保護觀念，引導其於創作過程中及早建立權利布局思維，將創意成果有效轉化為具市場價值的智慧資產。
智慧局表示，為提供創作者即時且完整的協助，展覽期間特別設置「智慧財產諮詢處」，由專業人員於 7 天展期現場提供專利、商標及著作權等實務諮詢，協助創作者釐清不同智慧財產權的保護範圍與申請策略，建立正確的保護觀念，鞏固創作成果的永續發展與權益保障。
此外，針對文創工作者常面臨的品牌經營及著作權議題，智慧局於展期內特別規劃專題講座，分享商標申請、品牌保護及著作權運用等實務重點，協助創作者提升智財管理能力並降低侵權風險。
智慧局強調，文化創意與智慧財產保護相輔相成，期待透過「台灣專利超級站」與參展業者及民眾面對面交流，不僅能即時回應相關疑義，更能協助創作者在創意商品化及商業化過程中建立完整的權利防護網。
智慧局熱情邀請所有參展業者、文創工作者及廣大民眾，即日至 12 日展覽期間親臨南港展覽館「台灣專利超級站」，體驗專業諮詢與精彩講座。若無法親臨現場，創作者亦可善用智慧局官網提供的各項線上資源與申請服務，即時掌握最新智財資訊。未來，智慧局「台灣專利超級站」將深入各類文創與設計場域，提供多元且專業的智慧財產服務，促進台灣文化創意產業永續發展。
paras_en: The Intellectual Property Office of the Ministry of Economic Affairs' "Taiwan Patent GO" will be present at the 2026 Taiwan Cultural and Creative Expo from August 6 to 12. The agency says this is the first time a "Taiwan Patent Super Station" is set up at the expo, creating a new benchmark for professional IP services at a national-level cultural‑creative event and demonstrating the government's commitment to integrating cultural creativity with intellectual‑property protection. During the exhibition, free IP consultations and themed talks will help brands and creators with original content, cultural characteristics or design value understand protection mechanisms, thereby enhancing the safeguarding of innovative results and market competitiveness.

The agency notes that this year’s Taiwan Expo has set records for the largest scale and longest duration in its history, with the theme “#ZeroBit” reflecting the rapid development of artificial intelligence and prompting visitors to rethink the nature and value of human creativity. By establishing the Taiwan Patent Super Station at the expo, the IP office is extending the patent, trademark and copyright protection network to the forefront of the cultural‑creative industry, promoting IP awareness among creators and encouraging early rights‑planning so that creative outputs can be effectively turned into market‑valuable intellectual assets.

To provide creators with timely and comprehensive assistance, a "Intellectual Property Consultation Desk" will be staffed on‑site for the seven‑day exhibition. Professionals will offer practical advice on patents, trademarks and copyrights, helping creators clarify the scope of protection and filing strategies, build correct protection concepts, and secure the sustainable development and rights of their works.

In addition, the office has arranged special seminars during the expo to address common brand‑management and copyright issues faced by cultural‑creative workers. The talks will cover key practical points on trademark applications, brand protection and copyright utilization, helping creators improve IP management skills and reduce infringement risk.

The agency stresses that cultural creativity and IP protection complement each other, and hopes that face‑to‑face interaction at the Taiwan Patent Super Station with exhibitors and the public will not only answer questions instantly but also help creators establish a comprehensive rights‑protection network during the commercialization of their ideas.

The IP office warmly invites all exhibitors, cultural‑creative workers and the general public to visit the Taiwan Patent Super Station at the Nangang Exhibition Hall from now until the 12th to experience professional consultations and engaging talks. Those unable to attend in person can use the online resources and application services available on the agency’s website to stay updated on the latest IP information. In the future, the Taiwan Patent Super Station will deepen its presence across various cultural‑creative and design fields, offering diverse and professional IP services to promote the sustainable development of Taiwan’s cultural‑creative industry.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台橡上半年獲利創近5年新高 股價跳空鎖漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Taiwan Rubber Posts Record Profit in First Half, Shares Surge
paras: 橡膠股台橡 (2103-TW) 受惠中國新廠量產、原料成本壓力減輕及產品報價調漲、毛利提升，上半年稅後純益 18.67 億元、年增 613%，創近 5 年新高，EPS 達 2.26 元，受財報亮眼激勵，台橡今 (7) 日開盤直接跳空漲停來到 25 元，在外資連 3 買與主力偏多支援下，出現補漲與業績行情。
台橡今年上半年營業毛利率為 17.01％、年增 7 個百分點；營益率 11.09％、年增 8.33 個百分點，受惠於中國新廠量產，加上綠色輪胎等高值化產品出貨增加，今日出現短線追價力道。
法人指出，上半年因中東情勢緊張，在伊朗封鎖荷莫茲海峽後，一度推升油價大幅上漲，也帶動丁二烯價格持續攀升，使得合成橡膠生產成本快速墊高，報價機制由季報價調整為「月報價」，讓業者也調整報價反映成本上揚，加上物流成本增加，也推升台橡的獲利空間。
台橡產品包括 SBR、BR、SIS 等，應用於輪胎、鞋材、醫療及工業材料，其中輪胎用橡膠仍是最大營收來源，近年公司積極提高高值化產品比重，例如高性能輪胎及醫療材料力拼轉型空間。
paras_en: Taiwan Rubber (2103-TW) benefited from China's new factory production, reduced raw material costs, and increased product prices, resulting in a net profit of NT$18.67 billion in the first half, up 613% year-over-year, a new high in nearly five years. Earnings per share (EPS) reached NT$2.26. The company's impressive earnings report prompted Taiwan Rubber to jump 25% to NT$25 at the opening on July 7, with foreign investors buying for the third consecutive day and institutional investors supporting the stock, leading to a surge in price and a strong earnings trend.

Taiwan Rubber's operating margin in the first half was 17.01%, up 7 percentage points year-over-year, while its operating profit margin was 11.09%, up 8.33 percentage points year-over-year. The company benefited from China's new factory production and increased sales of high-value products such as green tires, leading to a short-term buying trend.

A company insider pointed out that the Middle East situation was tense in the first half, with Iran blocking the Hormuz Strait, causing oil prices to surge significantly, and propylene prices to continue rising, resulting in a rapid increase in the production costs of synthetic rubber. The company adjusted its pricing mechanism from quarterly to monthly, allowing it to reflect the increase in costs. Additionally, increased logistics costs also boosted Taiwan Rubber's profit space.

Taiwan Rubber's products include SBR, BR, SIS, and others, which are used in tires, footwear, medical, and industrial materials. Tire rubber remains the largest revenue source, and the company has been actively increasing the proportion of high-value products in recent years, such as high-performance tires and medical materials, to transform and expand its business space.

items.title_en: Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. Sees Opportunities in the Aging Population
paras: 台灣正式邁入超高齡社會，台新新光金控 (2887-TW) 今 (7) 日起至 9 日，於「2026 高齡健康產業博覽會」盛大參展，總經理林維俊受訪時指出，隨著金管會日前核准銀行合併，集團未來將朝規模更大、業務更均衡的方向發展，透過整合銀行、保險、證券及投信的完整平台，提供一站式高齡整合方案。對於近期熱議的四貸同堂，他強調，台新銀向來秉持謹慎、保守的授信原則，未來也會維持嚴格的風險控管態度，他同時對台灣下半年的經濟展望抱持高度樂觀。
面對高齡市場的龐大潛力，林維俊表示，過去金融業多提供單一產品，但進入高齡社會後，民眾需要的是從預防醫療、健康管理到退休規劃、資產傳承的完整解決方案。台新新光金控的優勢在於以人為本的企業文化與完整的金融版圖，能陪伴客戶走過人生不同階段。

針對高齡族群最關注的金融詐騙問題，林維俊強調集團已全面導入 AI 防詐機制與高齡友善措施。台新銀行現場展示了「台新戰神模型」，能全天候透過 AI 分析異常交易與可疑行為，即時示警以阻斷詐騙；新光人壽則針對高齡保戶推出「家族聯絡網服務」，提供 60 歲以上長者預先設定「可信任聯絡人」，一旦發現疑似保單異常，便會主動聯繫共同確認，聯手築起資產安全防線。此外，台新銀行亦提供信託架構互動牆，推廣「預立信託」與「跨代傳承」觀念。
談及下半年金融市場展望，林維俊抱持樂觀看法。他觀察指出，目前資本市場活絡、金融業放款持續成長，顯示整體經濟活動熱度不減，且景氣並未偏離正常軌道，一切均在可控範圍內。
隨著台股交投熱絡，外界開始關注「四貸同堂」議題，憂心部分民眾擴大槓桿投入股市衍生風險。對此，林維俊重申，台新新光金控一直以來都秉持非常謹慎、保守的授信原則，未來也會持續維持一貫嚴格的風險控管態度。
2026 高齡健康產業博覽會於世貿一館展出，民眾參與攤位互動不僅能體驗各項 AI 創新服務，還有機會抽中價值萬元的基因檢測方案等多項大禮。台新新光金控期望透過科技與金融的結合，為國人長壽人生超前部署，精準守護幸福資產。

本次博覽會中，台新新光金控以「聰明理財存健康，AI 守護享樂活」為主題，整合旗下子公司資源。台新銀行 Richart Life 攜手新光人壽推出「Go 健康 GoFit」專區，首創健康分級回饋機制，鼓勵民眾養成健康習慣賺取點數；新光人壽則開創「重大傷病險 × 基因檢測自由選」生態圈，推出「溢卡安心」重大傷病險，並結合嘉和健康集團的高端 DNA 解碼技術，達到早預防的效果。此外，為補足長者退休資金，新光人壽同步推出「安心退休有保障平台」，協助規劃第三筆退休金；台新證券也透過「好富投 APP」提供智慧選股與防詐提醒，陪伴投資人穩健布局。
paras_en: Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. (2887-TW) officially entered the super-aged society in Taiwan, and today (7) to 9, participated in the "2026 Aging Health Industry Expo". General Manager Lin Wei-jun stated that, following the recent approval by the Financial Supervisory Commission, the group will develop in the direction of larger scale and more balanced business, providing a one-stop aging integration solution through the integration of banks, insurance, securities, and investment trust platforms. Regarding the recent hot topic of four loans together, he emphasized that Chinatrust Bank has always adhered to a cautious and conservative lending principle, and will continue to maintain a strict risk management attitude in the future. He also expressed a high degree of optimism about Taiwan's economic prospects in the second half of the year.

Facing the huge potential of the aging market, Lin Wei-jun stated that, in the past, the financial industry has provided single products, but after entering the aging society, people need a comprehensive solution from preventive medicine, health management, retirement planning, and asset inheritance. Chinatrust Financial Holding Co.'s advantage lies in its people-centered corporate culture and complete financial map, which can accompany customers through different stages of life.

Regarding the financial fraud problem that is most concerned by the aging population, Lin Wei-jun emphasized that the group has fully introduced AI anti-fraud mechanisms and aging-friendly measures. Chinatrust Bank has showcased the "Chinatrust War God Model" at the scene, which can analyze abnormal transactions and suspicious behavior through AI analysis 24/7, and immediately alert to prevent fraud. New Fubon Life has launched the "Family Contact Network Service" for high-age policyholders, providing a pre-set "trusted contact person" for those over 60, and if suspicious policy anomalies are found, it will actively contact and confirm together to build a secure asset defense line. In addition, Chinatrust Bank also provides a trust framework interactive wall to promote the concept of "pre-established trusts" and "cross-generation inheritance".

Regarding the economic prospects of the second half of the year, Lin Wei-jun expressed a positive outlook. He observed that the capital market is currently active, and financial institutions continue to grow lending, indicating that overall economic activity remains hot, and the economy has not deviated from the normal track, and everything is within controllable limits.

As the stock market is hot, the outside world has begun to pay attention to the "four loans together" issue, worrying that some people will expand their leverage and invest in stock market derivatives risks. In response, Lin Wei-jun reiterated that Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. has always adhered to a very cautious and conservative lending principle, and will continue to maintain a strict risk management attitude in the future.

The 2026 Aging Health Industry Expo is being held at the World Trade Center, and visitors can not only experience various AI innovative services, but also have the opportunity to win a genetic testing scheme worth one million yuan and other major gifts. Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. hopes to use technology and finance to pre-deploy a long and healthy life for the people, and accurately protect their assets.

At this expo, Chinatrust Financial Holding Co. has taken "Smart Finance, Healthy Life, AI Protection, Enjoyment, and Happiness" as the theme, integrating the resources of its subsidiary companies. Chinatrust Bank's Richart Life has partnered with New Fubon Life to launch the "Go Healthy GoFit" zone, creating a health level return mechanism for the first time, encouraging people to develop healthy habits and earn points; New Fubon Life has created a "Major Injury Insurance x Genetic Testing Free Choice" ecosystem, launching the "Surplus Card Anxiang" major injury insurance, and combining the high-end DNA decoding technology of Jiahe Health Group to achieve early prevention. In addition, to supplement the retirement funds of the elderly, New Fubon Life has simultaneously launched the "Anxiang Retirement Security Platform" to help plan the third retirement pension; Chinatrust Securities has also used the "Good Rich Investment APP" to provide intelligent stock selection and anti-fraud reminders, accompanying investors to make stable layouts.

items.title: 英飛凌攜手聯發科 卡位車規NOR Flash缺貨商機
items.title_en: Micron Partners with Mediatek to Capture NOR Flash Opportunity in Automotive
paras: 英飛凌今 (7) 日宣布與聯發科 (2454-TW) 合作，為未來車輛打造先進、AI 驅動的汽車座艙體驗。英飛凌車規級 NOR Flash 已完成在 Dimensity Auto Cockpit 平台 C-X1 上的認證，為車廠、Tier-1 供應商，以及開發下一代智慧座艙系統的設計合作夥伴提供通過認證且易於採用的記憶體選項。

英飛凌記憶體解決方案部門資深副總裁 Rainer Hoehler 表示，車用記憶體實現創新的關鍵推手，因為軟體定義車輛仰賴高效能系統單晶片 (SoCs)、日益複雜的韌體，以及大量資料儲存。前瞻的數位座艙與 OTA(無線軟體更新) 能力正驅動對更高容量 NOR Flash 的需求。通過聯發科認證後，客戶將可更輕鬆地採用英飛凌 512 Mb NOR Flash ，打造面向未來的智慧座艙記憶體解決方案。
聯發科副總兼汽車業務總經理張豫臺表示，英飛凌車規級 NOR Flash 提供公司高階旗艦級的 Dimensity Auto Cockpit 平台 C-X1 更高的效能、可靠性與功能安全。其高容量設計可支援下一代軟體定義汽車 (SDV) 中不可或缺的先進 AI 與使用者體驗功能。在雙方長期合作的基礎上，我們善用英飛凌在產業中的領先優勢，為持續演進的軟體定義生態系提供可靠的關鍵基礎。

英飛凌 512 Mb QSPI NOR Flash 記憶體可儲存韌體與開機程式碼，以支援 SoC 層級的 AI 驅動功能，例如語音助理、駕駛監控、行車旅拍 (vlog) 生成、環境感知，以及個人化影音推薦。該解決方案支援功能安全且加密的開機 (safe and security boot) ，亦提供關鍵備援功能以提升安全性。這款產品採用英飛凌 MirrorBit 技術，具備強固的介面、可與主流車用 SoC 廣泛相容、通過 AEC‑Q100 認證，並支援最高 +125°C 的工作溫度。
paras_en: Micron today announced a collaboration with Mediatek (2454-TW) to create advanced, AI-driven in-vehicle experiences for future vehicles. Micron's automotive-grade NOR Flash has completed certification on the Dimensity Auto Cockpit platform C-X1, providing a certified and adoptable memory option for OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and design partners developing next-generation intelligent cockpit systems.

Rainer Hoehler, senior vice president of Micron's memory solutions business, stated that automotive memory is a key enabler of innovation, as software-defined vehicles rely on high-performance system-on-chip (SoCs), increasingly complex firmware, and large data storage. Forward-looking digital cockpits and over-the-air (OTA) capabilities are driving demand for higher-capacity NOR Flash. Following Mediatek's certification, customers can more easily adopt Micron's 512 Mb NOR Flash to create forward-looking intelligent cockpit memory solutions.

Mediatek's vice president and automotive business general manager, Zhang Yu Tai, stated that Micron's automotive-grade NOR Flash provides the company's high-end flagship Dimensity Auto Cockpit platform C-X1 with higher performance, reliability, and functional safety. Its high-capacity design can support the advanced AI and user experience functions essential to next-generation software-defined vehicles (SDV). Building on their long-term collaboration, we leverage Micron's industry-leading advantages to provide a reliable foundation for the continuously evolving software-defined ecosystem.

Micron's 512 Mb QSPI NOR Flash memory can store firmware and boot code to support SoC-level AI-driven functions, such as voice assistants, driver monitoring, in-vehicle video generation (vlog), environmental perception, and personalized audio recommendations. The solution supports secure and encrypted boot (safe and security boot) and provides critical redundancy functions to enhance security. This product uses Micron's MirrorBit technology, featuring a robust interface, wide compatibility with mainstream automotive SoCs, AEC-Q100 certification, and support for up to +125°C operating temperatures.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro漲價+缺貨雙重夾擊！A20 Pro良率高卻卡在DRAM 華爾街：新機1399美元起跳
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Faces Double Whammy: Price Hike and Shortage
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，距離 iPhone 18 系列發表倒數幾周，蘋果新機正面臨「成本暴衝＋DRAM 斷料」雙重夾擊，漲價幾成定局，首發缺貨亦難避免。
美國科技媒體《9to5mac》引述供應鏈與機構測算指出，漲價底氣來自三項硬體成本。一是全球 DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體持續緊缺、記憶體現貨價格暴漲；二是全新可變光圈主鏡頭成本較上一代增加 50%；三是首發台積電 2 奈米 A20 Pro 晶片搭配 WMCM 封裝，先進製程費用大幅墊高。
根據華爾街測算，為守住基本毛利，新機最低定價需 1299 美元，若計入影像溢價，蘋果很可能把 Pro 起售價鎖在 1399 美元，較此前同款漲價 300 美元；Pro Max 同步上調。
《彭博資訊》此前報導亦稱 Pro 漲幅介於 100 至 200 美元，僅摩根大通認為可透過零件優化對沖部分壓力。以 1299 美元試算，機型毛利率將從上代 47% 降至 44%，支撐 1399 美元站位。
產能端更棘手。A20 Pro 晶圓良率穩定、台積電產線正常，但專用 DRAM 供貨缺口巨大，已產出晶片無法完成 WMCM 整合封裝，台積電超 10 億美元等級的蘋果處理器產能被迫空轉。
供應鏈預判，iPhone 18 首發初期能保基礎鋪貨，但線上等待期拉長、線下門市現貨快速見底。
雪上加霜的是產品線收縮：今秋取消標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone Air 2(延至 2027 初)，僅留 iPhone Ultra 與 18 Pro 系列，入門款需求全數灌向 Pro，供需矛盾被進一步放大。
對消費者而言，新一代 Pro 不是「買不買得起」的單選，而是「付 1399 美元還要等多久」的雙重考驗。
對蘋果來說，DRAM 漲價潮正把硬體定價權從品牌溢價，部分交還給記憶體廠。
paras_en: A few weeks before the release of the iPhone 18 series, Apple's new machine is facing a double whammy of 'cost explosion + DRAM shortage', with a price hike almost certain and initial shortages unavoidable.

According to a report by US tech media 9to5mac, citing supply chain and institutional estimates, the price hike is driven by three hardware costs. Firstly, the global shortage of DRAM and NAND flash memory has led to a sharp increase in memory prices. Secondly, the new variable aperture main camera costs 50% more than the previous generation. Thirdly, the use of TSMC's 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip with WMCM packaging has significantly increased the cost of the advanced process.

According to Wall Street estimates, to maintain a basic profit margin, the new machine's minimum price would need to be $1,299. If image premium is factored in, Apple is likely to set the Pro starting price at $1,399, a $300 increase from the previous generation, with Pro Max following suit.

A previous report by Bloomberg Information also estimated that the Pro price hike would be between $100 and $200. However, Morgan Stanley believes that component optimization could help offset some of the pressure. At $1,299, the machine's profit margin would drop from 47% to 44%, supporting a $1,399 price point.

The production end is even more complicated. The A20 Pro chip has a stable yield rate, and TSMC's production lines are normal, but the shortage of specialized DRAM is massive. The produced chips cannot be completed with WMCM integration packaging, and TSMC's Apple processor production capacity has been forced to idle, with losses exceeding $1 billion.

Supply chain predictions indicate that the initial shipment of iPhone 18 will be able to meet basic demand, but online waiting periods will be extended, and offline store inventory will quickly dwindle.

Adding to the woes is the product line contraction: the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 (delayed to early 2027) will be canceled, leaving only the iPhone Ultra and 18 Pro series. The entry-level demand will be fully shifted to Pro, further exacerbating the supply-demand contradiction.
For consumers, the new Pro series is not a 'can't afford it' option, but a 'can I afford it and wait for how long' double test.
For Apple, the DRAM price surge is taking away the company's hardware pricing power, partly returning it to memory manufacturers.

items.title: AI資料中心需求升溫，Microchip財測優於預期，盤後股價漲7%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Demand Heats Up, Microchip Forecast Beats Expectations, After-Hours Stock Rises 7%

items.title: 輝達終結連五紅 財報將成下一個催化劑
items.title_en: Nvidia Ends Five-Day Rally, Earnings Report to Be Next Catalyst
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 周四 (6 日) 一度延續漲勢，但最終未能守住盤中漲幅。市場認為，其將於本月稍晚公布的財報，可能成為推動股價進一步走高的關鍵催化劑。
輝達終場下跌 0.1%，收在 218.99 美元，終結連續五個交易日上漲。當天一度漲至 223.63 美元，隨後回吐全部漲幅。
輝達也是周四標普 500 指數成交量最大個股，以及那斯達克 100 指數成交量第二大股票。
今年以來，輝達股價已上漲 17.3%，過去 12 個月累計漲幅達 21%。
市場可能持續看好輝達在 AI 晶片市場的主導地位。最新跡象之一就是馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 日前透露，SpaceX(SPACEX-US)未來將全面採用輝達的硬體產品。
除此之外，輝達在所謂的主權 AI(Sovereign AI) 領域也占壓倒性優勢。據 Counterpoint Research 周三公布數據，92% 的主權 AI 模型都是使用輝達晶片完成訓練。
輝達 2026 會計年度來自主權 AI 的營收已較去年同期成長逾三倍，突破 300 億美元，公司也寄望未來持續擴大這項業務。
Counterpoint Research 研究總監 Marc Einstein 表示，「隨著主權 AI 基礎設施持續擴張，輝達正於全球各地簽署多項數十億美元規模的合作案，希望掌握下一波 AI 浪潮，也就是 AI 推論以及建設主權 AI 工廠。」
市場下一個重要催化劑，預料將是 8 月 26 日公布的輝達財報。公司股價通常會在財報公布前表現強勢，但財報發布後往往回落，因此市場將觀察這次是否能打破這項走勢。
Susquehanna 分析師 Christopher Jacobson 在研究報告中寫道，「由於輝達股價自上次財報公布後仍處於下跌狀態，我們再次回到先前的觀察，也就是輝達在每季財報公布前的『季中』交易模式，尤其是財報公布前 2 至 3 周通常會出現一波漲勢。」
他補充表示，「我們注意到，目前正好進入這段財報前期間，而在過去八個季中，這段時間的股價表現一直相當強勁。」
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) extended its rally on Thursday, but ultimately failed to hold onto its intraday gains, according to a report by Barron's. The market believes that the company's upcoming earnings report, to be released later this month, could be the key catalyst to drive the stock price even higher.
Nvidia ended the day down 0.1%, closing at $218.99, marking the end of its five-day winning streak. The stock briefly touched $223.63 before reversing all its gains.
Nvidia was also the largest traded stock on the S&P 500 index and the second-largest traded stock on the Nasdaq 100 index on Thursday.
This year, Nvidia's stock has risen 17.3%, with a cumulative gain of 21% over the past 12 months.

The market may continue to be optimistic about Nvidia's dominance in the AI chip market. One of the latest signs is that Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX (SPACEX-US), recently revealed that the company will fully adopt Nvidia's hardware products in the future.

In addition, Nvidia has a significant lead in the so-called Sovereign AI domain. According to data released by Counterpoint Research on Wednesday, 92% of Sovereign AI models are trained using Nvidia chips.

Nvidia's revenue from Sovereign AI in its 2026 fiscal year has grown more than threefold compared to the same period last year, exceeding $30 billion. The company hopes to continue expanding this business in the future.

Marc Einstein, research director at Counterpoint Research, said, "As the Sovereign AI infrastructure continues to expand, Nvidia is signing multiple multi-billion-dollar deals around the world, hoping to capture the next wave of AI, which is AI inference and building Sovereign AI factories."

The next important catalyst for the market is expected to be Nvidia's earnings report on August 26. The company's stock typically performs strongly before the earnings report is released, but often falls after the report is published, so the market will be watching to see if this trend is broken.

Susquehanna analyst Christopher Jacobson wrote in a research report, "Given that Nvidia's stock price has remained in a downtrend since the last earnings report, we are once again returning to our previous observation, which is Nvidia's 'mid-quarter' trading pattern, especially the 2-3 weeks before the earnings report."
He added, "We note that we are currently in this pre-earnings period, and in the past eight mid-quarters, the stock price has performed extremely strongly."

items.title: 華爾街不信AI紅利能持久？SanDisk、美光估值跌至科技股谷底 6倍本益比引兩派論戰
items.title_en: Wall Street Questions AI Premium Sustainability: SanDisk, Micron Valuations Plummet to Tech Stock Lows
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 帶動高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 與企業級儲存需求爆發，記憶體廠商獲利預估持續上修，但市場給予的估值卻反而降至大型科技股最低水準。SanDisk (SNDK-US)與美光科技 (Micron Technology) (MU-US) 目前前瞻本益比僅約 6 倍，引發市場討論，究竟是遭到低估，還是反映投資人擔憂記憶體景氣循環終將反轉。
根據市場資料，目前 SanDisk (SNDK-US)以 6.0 倍前瞻本益比，成為美國大型科技股中估值最低的公司；美光科技 (MU-US) 則以 6.3 倍居次。兩家公司今年股價分別累計大漲 444.4% 與 216.1%，但華爾街仍以接近景氣循環谷底企業的估值標準看待兩家公司。
相較之下，GoDaddy (GDDY-US)前瞻本益比為 8.6 倍，今年股價下跌 28.2%；超微電腦 (Super Micro Computer) (SMCI-US) 為 8.9 倍，仍較歷史高點低 75.4%；Adobe (ADBE-US)為 9.9 倍，今年跌 26.7%；Gartner (IT-US)則為 11.7 倍，距歷史高點仍有 68.8% 的差距。
資料來源：Koyfin
值得注意的是，兩家記憶體公司的低估值並非來自獲利預測遭下修，反而是在市場持續調高未來獲利預估的情況下形成。
市場目前預估，SanDisk (SNDK-US)未來 12 個月每股獲利 (EPS) 可達 214.32 美元，較 3 個月前約 168 美元大幅提高 27.6%，但股價仍較歷史高點回落約 46%。
美光科技 (MU-US) 情況亦相似，分析師目前預估未來 12 個月 EPS 將達 144.21 美元，較 3 個月前約 114 美元提高 26.7%，但股價仍較歷史高點低約 29%。
市場人士指出，這代表股價下跌速度遠高於獲利預期上修速度，因此使本益比快速壓縮。
不過，也有分析認為，記憶體向來是半導體產業中景氣循環最劇烈的領域之一，歷史經驗顯示，記憶體股往往正是在獲利接近高峰時，本益比最低。隨著供給逐漸增加、價格回落，企業獲利可能快速下降，屆時目前看似便宜的 6 倍本益比，很可能迅速升高。
然而，AI 是否改變產業循環，正成為市場最大爭論焦點。
在最新財報中，SanDisk (SNDK-US) 表示，公司推動多年期供貨合約與固定價格、保底價格的新商業模式，預估 2027 財年將涵蓋超過一半出貨位元 (bit)，2028 財年可提高至約三分之二，相關長約合計提供 165 億美元財務保障，藉此降低記憶體價格波動風險。
另一方面，美光科技 (MU-US) 近期亦表示，公司已與客戶簽署 16 項長期供貨協議，合約期限延伸至 2030 年。公司最新財測預估本季營收約為 500 億美元，前一季營收則為 414.6 億美元，顯示 AI 需求仍維持強勁。
近期包括美光、SK 海力士及三星電子等主要 HBM 供應商均表示，2026 年與 2027 年高頻寬記憶體產能大多已提前售罄，AI 伺服器持續帶動 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 需求，加上大型雲端服務供應商持續擴大 AI 資料中心投資，使市場開始重新評估記憶體產業是否已進入不同於過去的新景氣循環。
分析人士指出，若 AI 長期需求足以支撐記憶體價格與企業獲利維持高檔，目前約 6 倍的前瞻本益比將顯得相當便宜；反之，若 AI 需求最終仍回歸傳統半導體景氣循環，目前的低估值可能只是反映市場預期獲利接近高峰。
換言之，SanDisk (SNDK-US)與美光科技 (MU-US) 如今已成為 AI 投資熱潮下最具代表性的估值觀察指標，市場真正關心的不只是 AI 需求是否持續成長，而是 AI 是否足以永久改變記憶體產業過去高度循環的商業模式。
paras_en: The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has driven a surge in demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and enterprise storage, leading to profit estimates for memory manufacturers being consistently revised upwards. However, the market's valuation of these companies has plummeted to the lowest level among large tech stocks, sparking debate over whether they are undervalued or reflect investors' concerns about the cyclical nature of the memory industry.

According to market data, SanDisk (SNDK-US) currently has a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 6.0, making it the most undervalued company among US large-cap tech stocks, while Micron Technology (MU-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 6.3. Despite their stock prices increasing by 444.4% and 216.1% respectively this year, Wall Street views both companies as if they were at the bottom of the industry cycle.

In contrast, GoDaddy (GDDY-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 8.6, with a stock price decline of 28.2% this year; Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 8.9, still lower than its historical high by 75.4%; Adobe (ADBE-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 9.9, with a stock price decline of 26.7%; and Gartner (IT-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 11.7, still 68.8% below its historical high.
Data source: Koyfin
Notably, the low valuations of the two memory companies are not due to downward revisions in profit estimates, but rather the market's continued upward revisions in future earnings estimates.

The market currently estimates that SanDisk (SNDK-US) will achieve earnings per share (EPS) of $214.32 over the next 12 months, a 27.6% increase from the $168 estimated three months ago. However, the stock price has fallen by approximately 46% from its historical high.

Micron Technology (MU-US) has a similar situation, with analysts estimating that the company will achieve EPS of $144.21 over the next 12 months, a 26.7% increase from the $114 estimated three months ago. However, the stock price has fallen by approximately 29% from its historical high.
Market participants point out that this represents a significant compression of the forward P/E ratio, as the stock price decline has outpaced the upward revision in earnings estimates.

However, some analysts argue that the memory industry has historically been one of the most cyclical in the semiconductor industry, with memory stocks often experiencing a low P/E ratio when earnings are near their peak. As supply increases and prices fall, corporate earnings may rapidly decline, making the current 6x forward P/E ratio appear attractive.
However, the question of whether AI will change the industry's cyclical nature has become the biggest point of contention in the market.

In its latest earnings report, SanDisk (SNDK-US) stated that the company has been driving a new business model with multi-year supply contracts and fixed prices, with the goal of covering over half of its output by 2027 and increasing to approximately 3/4 by 2028. This is expected to provide $16.5 billion in financial protection and reduce the risk of memory price volatility.

On the other hand, Micron Technology (MU-US) has recently announced that it has signed 16 long-term supply agreements with customers, with contract terms extending to 2030. The company's latest earnings estimate is $50 billion in revenue for the current quarter and $41.46 billion for the previous quarter, indicating that AI demand remains strong.

Major HBM suppliers, including Micron, SK Hynix, and Samsung Electronics, have recently stated that their 2026 and 2027 HBM production capacity is largely sold out, driven by AI server demand and large cloud service providers' continued investment in AI data centers. This has led the market to reassess whether the memory industry has entered a new cycle.

Analysts point out that if AI demand can sustainably support memory prices and corporate earnings at high levels, the current forward P/E ratio of approximately 6 would be considered undervalued. Conversely, if AI demand ultimately returns to traditional semiconductor industry cycles, the current low valuations may simply reflect market expectations of earnings near their peak.

In other words, SanDisk (SNDK-US) and Micron Technology (MU-US) have become the most representative valuation benchmarks in the AI investment frenzy, with the market's true concern being whether AI can permanently change the memory industry's cyclical business model.

items.title: 特斯拉打造超大Terafab晶片園區 這些個股可望受惠
items.title_en: Tesla to Build Massive Terafab Chip Complex, These Stocks May Benefit
paras: 《Seeking Alpha》報導，特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 周四 (6 日) 證實，旗下大型晶片製造園區 Terafab 將落腳美國德州 Grimes County。公司今年 4 月已在德州超級工廠（Giga Texas）北園區為研究型晶圓廠動工，並稱該設施將成為 Terafab 的前身。初期投資金額為 168 億美元。
簡單來說，Terafab 是一座規劃中的超大型半導體製造園區，由特斯拉、SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及 xAI 共同打造，目標是以前所未有的規模生產先進 AI 晶片。
Terafab 被設計成一座垂直整合的「晶片城」，將晶片設計、晶圓製造、記憶體生產、先進封裝及測試等主要製程，全都整合在同一園區內，而不是像目前產業慣例，分散於不同公司及不同廠區完成。
其目標是每年打造超過 1 太瓦 (terawatt) 的 AI 算力，供應特斯拉的電動車及 Optimus 人形機器人所需晶片，同時支援 SpaceX 與 xAI 規劃中的太空 AI 資料中心及太陽能衛星。
展望未來，馬斯克旗下企業希望藉由大規模垂直整合晶片設計與製造，大幅降低 AI 晶片成本，並縮小當前全球晶片供應不足與未來龐大需求之間的落差。
公司表示，「特斯拉與 SpaceX 所需的晶片數量，都將遠遠超過目前及未來全球的供應能力。因此，我們正打造史上最大的晶片製造設施，目標是每年生產超過 1 太瓦的 AI 算力。」
分析師初步認為，Terafab 的大規模投資可望帶動半導體設備供應鏈需求，英特爾 (INTC-US)、艾司摩爾 (ASML-US)、應用材料 (AMAT-US)、科林研發 (LRCX-US) 及科磊 (KLAC-US) 等公司，都有望成為受惠者。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) confirmed on Thursday (6th) that its massive chip manufacturing complex, Terafab, will be located in Grimes County, Texas, according to a Seeking Alpha report.
In simple terms, Terafab is a planned massive semiconductor manufacturing complex jointly developed by Tesla, SpaceX (SPCX-US), and xAI, aiming to produce advanced AI chips on an unprecedented scale.

Terafab is designed as a vertically integrated 'chip city' where chip design, wafer manufacturing, memory production, advanced packaging, and testing will be integrated within the same complex, unlike the current industry practice of dispersing these processes across different companies and facilities.

The goal is to produce over 1 terawatt of AI computing power per year to supply chips for Tesla's electric cars and Optimus humanoid robots, while also supporting SpaceX and xAI's planned space AI data center and solar satellite.

Looking ahead, Musk's companies hope to achieve significant cost reductions in AI chip production through large-scale vertical integration and bridge the gap between current global chip supply shortages and future massive demand.

The company stated, 'The number of chips required by Tesla and SpaceX will far exceed the current and future global supply capacity. Therefore, we are building the largest chip manufacturing facility in history, aiming to produce over 1 terawatt of AI computing power per year.'

Analysts believe that the massive investment in Terafab may drive demand for semiconductor equipment supply chains, benefiting companies such as Intel (INTC-US), ASML (ASML-US), Applied Materials (AMAT-US), LAM Research (LRCX-US), and KLA Corporation (KLAC-US).

items.title: 大摩翻多記憶體股：最劇烈修正已過 AI需求支撐新一波行情 看好三星、海力士
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Turns Bullish on Memory Stocks: Worst Correction Over, AI Demand to Drive Next Wave of Growth, Favoring Samsung and SK Hynix
paras: 摩根士丹利最新發布的記憶體產業研究報告指出，記憶體產業今年以來經歷的大幅修正已接近尾聲，市場焦點將逐步由價格循環轉向資本回饋，包括股票回購、自由現金流及長期供貨協議 (LTA) 等因素，有望成為下一波推升股價的重要催化劑。被喻為「空頭」代言人的分析師 Shawn Kim 認為，目前估值已提供具吸引力的戰術性進場時機，近期修正僅是 AI 超級循環中的一段正常波動。
報告指出，摩根士丹利早在 7 月初便提醒，記憶體股因 DRAM 價格漲勢即將放緩，以及市場持倉過度集中，可能出現短期回調。此後雖然市場對 AI 資本支出及 AI 需求仍維持樂觀，但也開始注意到 4Q26 起 DRAM 價格增幅趨緩、庫存逐步回升及新增供給增加等現象，使市場對後續獲利驚喜有所保留。不過，分析師認為，經過近期修正後，記憶體股估值已明顯改善，未來資本回報政策可望加速。

摩根士丹利表示，AI 帶動的需求與傳統記憶體景氣循環並不衝突。雖然 DRAM 價格同比增速可能已見高點，但此次 AI 建置周期規模遠超歷史，價格年增幅一度高達 700%，約為歷史高峰的 7 倍。DRAM 已成為 AI 基礎建設的重要瓶頸之一，但目前市場對相關個股僅給予約 3 倍未來 12 個月本益比 (NTM P/E)，幾乎沒有反映長期成長溢價。報告認為，若投資人開始相信 AI 將延長產業獲利周期，估值倍數仍有擴張空間。
針對個別企業，摩根士丹利維持三星電子 (Samsung Electronics) 及 SK 海力士 (SK hynix) 目標價不變，但調整獲利預估。其中，SK 海力士 2026 年每股盈餘 (EPS) 預估上調 13%，反映第二季資產處分收益；三星電子則因消費性電子業務疲弱，2026 年 EPS 預估下修 10%，2027 年至 2028 年預測則僅小幅調整。
報告認為，記憶體產業將自 2026 年第四季進入周期後段，未來企業將更重視資本回饋、長期供貨協議 (LTA)、穩定獲利能力及自由現金流表現，而非依賴價格快速上漲帶來的營運槓桿。近期獲利預估修正幅度已明顯降溫，顯示最悲觀時期可能已經過去。
產業調查顯示，3Q26 DRAM 合約價格於初期交易約季增 15%，略低於摩根士丹利原先預估的 20%；3Q26 NAND 價格則約季增 20%。隨著 4Q26 價格漲幅趨緩，客戶提前備貨意願有所下降，但更多產能預料將由消費性產品轉向企業級 SSD(eSSD)，配合 AI 伺服器需求持續成長，可望消化新增供給。
報告進一步指出，目前市場已充分反映未來 12 個月 EPS 成長放緩風險，但 AI 帶動的需求更可能屬於結構性改變，而非單純周期循環。因此，以過去周期股的估值方式評價記憶體產業，未必仍然適用；未來若企業積極提高股東回報，將有助市場重新評價整體產業。

摩根士丹利最後維持長線樂觀看法，認為 AI 資本支出、Agentic AI 快速發展，以及三星電子與 SK 海力士 2027 年獲利可望成長 25% 至 50%，均將支撐產業基本面。報告估計，兩家公司目標價相較目前股價仍隱含超過 60% 的上行空間。短期而言，7 月大幅平倉後，市場追價資金已重新回流，預料仍將偏好 AI 資本支出受惠最大的 DRAM 及利基型記憶體，包括 DDR4 與 SLC NAND，而非記憶體模組廠商。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley's latest research report on the memory industry states that the significant correction experienced by the industry this year is nearing its end. The market's focus will shift from price cycles to capital returns, including stock buybacks, free cash flow, and long-term supply agreements (LTA), which are expected to become key catalysts for the next wave of stock price growth. Analyst Shawn Kim believes that current valuations provide an attractive opportunity for tactical entry, and the recent correction is just a normal fluctuation within the AI super cycle.

The report notes that Morgan Stanley warned in early July that memory stocks might experience a short-term correction due to the impending slowdown in DRAM price growth and overly concentrated market positions. Although the market remains optimistic about AI capital expenditures and demand, it has also begun to notice the slowing growth of DRAM prices starting from 4Q26, the gradual increase in inventory, and the rise in new supply, leading to a more cautious outlook on future earnings. However, the analyst believes that after the recent correction, memory stock valuations have improved significantly, and future capital return policies are expected to accelerate.

Morgan Stanley states that AI-driven demand does not conflict with traditional memory industry cycles. Although the year-over-year growth rate of DRAM prices may have peaked, the scale of this AI construction cycle far exceeds historical levels, with price growth reaching 700% at one point, approximately seven times the historical peak. DRAM has become a crucial bottleneck in AI infrastructure, but the market currently only gives related stocks a price-to-earnings ratio (NTM P/E) of around 3 times, barely reflecting long-term growth premiums. The report believes that if investors start to believe that AI will extend the industry's profit cycle, valuation multiples still have room for expansion.

Regarding individual companies, Morgan Stanley maintains its target prices for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix but adjusts its earnings estimates. SK Hynix's 2026 EPS estimate is revised upward by 13% to reflect the gains from asset disposals in the second quarter, while Samsung Electronics' 2026 EPS estimate is revised downward by 10% due to weak consumer electronics business, with only minor adjustments to its 2027 and 2028 forecasts.

The report believes that the memory industry will enter the late cycle from the fourth quarter of 2026, and companies will focus more on capital returns, long-term supply agreements (LTA), stable profitability, and free cash flow performance rather than relying on rapid price increases for operational leverage. The recent earnings estimate revisions have significantly cooled down, indicating that the most pessimistic period may have passed.

Industry surveys show that 3Q26 DRAM contract prices rose by around 15% in initial trading, slightly lower than Morgan Stanley's original estimate of 20%; 3Q26 NAND prices rose by approximately 20%. As the price growth slows down in 4Q26, customers' willingness to stock up in advance has decreased, but more capacity is expected to shift from consumer products to enterprise-level SSDs (eSSD) to meet the growing demand for AI servers, which can absorb new supply.

The report further points out that the market has already fully reflected the risk of slowing EPS growth over the next 12 months, but AI-driven demand is more likely to represent a structural change rather than a simple cyclical fluctuation. Therefore, evaluating the memory industry using the valuation methods of past cyclical stocks may no longer be applicable; if companies actively increase shareholder returns in the future, it will help the market reevaluate the entire industry.

Morgan Stanley maintains its long-term optimistic outlook, believing that AI capital expenditures, the rapid development of Agentic AI, and the expected 25% to 50% growth in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's earnings in 2027 will support the industry's fundamentals. The report estimates that the target prices of the two companies still imply more than 60% upside potential compared to current stock prices. In the short term, after the significant unwinding in July, market funds have flowed back in and are expected to continue favoring DRAM and niche memory types, such as DDR4 and SLC NAND, that benefit most from AI capital expenditures, rather than memory module manufacturers.

items.title: AMD收購AI晶片新創Taalas 專用晶片號稱比GPU快數千倍
items.title_en: AMD Acquires AI Chip Startup Taalas, Claims Its Chips Are Thousands of Times Faster Than GPUs
paras: 《CNBC》報導，AMD(AMD-US)周四 (6 日) 宣布已達成協議收購加拿大 AI 晶片新創 Taalas。該公司專注於 AI 推論晶片，其加速器並非通用型設計，而是針對單一 AI 模型量身打造。
AMD 正依靠旗下 GPU 帶動資料中心業務成長，隨著雲端服務業者持續搶購先進 AI 晶片，GPU 仍是主要成長動能。但隨著生成式 AI 熱潮即將邁入第四年，市場逐漸發現，GPU 並非適用於所有 AI 工作負載。
雖然 Taalas 的設計犧牲了晶片的通用性，但該公司表示，其技術可打造成本更低的晶片，並在特定模型上，以比傳統 GPU 快數千倍的速度完成推論。
AMD 發言人拒絕透露此次交易金額。Taalas 自 2023 年成立以來，已累計募得 2.19 億美元創投資金。
此次收購距離輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 斥資 200 億美元收購高效能 AI 晶片設計公司 Groq 相關資產僅約七個多月，也是輝達歷來規模最大的收購案。
Taalas 目前推出的晶片可運行 Meta(META-US)旗下 Llama 3.1 小型版本，公司也正開發可支援更大型、更先進模型的晶片。其晶片採用台積電 (TSM-US) 較舊的製程生產，並在晶片上搭載高速 SRAM 記憶體。
Taalas 執行長 Ljubisa Bajic 在公司網站表示，「我們打造了一個平台，可以將任何 AI 模型轉換為專屬矽晶片。從收到一個過去從未見過的新模型開始，只需要兩個月，就能將它實現在硬體上。」
像 Taalas 與 Groq 這類替代性 AI 晶片，對於「低延遲」應用尤其重要，因為這類應用十分重視 AI 模型首次回應的速度。
AMD 執行長蘇姿丰 7 月在產品發表會上表示，「我一直相信，晶片並不存在一體適用的解決方案。」她也指出，AMD 仍預期 GPU 將占 AI 晶片市場的大部分比重，因為 GPU 具足夠彈性，可支援不斷推出的新 AI 模型。
GPU 需求已推升輝達成為全球市值最高企業，市值超過 5 兆美元。
這項收購也反映出，領先 GPU 製造商愈來愈重視提供整合式 AI 系統，而非僅銷售單一處理器。AMD 近期已開始向包括 Meta 及微軟 (MSFT-US) 在內的客戶出貨 Helios，這是 AMD 首款與輝達整合式 AI 伺服器機櫃競爭的機櫃級產品。
AMD 表示，未來將把 Taalas 的晶片與技術納入產品藍圖，整合至包括 CPU 及 Instinct GPU 等系統中。
此外，AMD 也持續布局其他 AI 加速器。今年 7 月，公司宣布與 Cerebras 合作，預計今年稍晚將其 AI 晶片整合至系統中。
AMD 近年來積極透過收購，補足打造 Helios 機櫃所需的各項技術與零組件。2024 年，AMD 以 6.65 億美元收購 AI 模型開發商 Silo AI，並以 49 億美元收購 ZT Systems，後者提供了機櫃級產品的技術基礎。去年，AMD 也收購多家小型 AI 公司，包括專注於推論軟體的 MK1。
paras_en: AMD (AMD-US) announced on Thursday (6th) that it has reached an agreement to acquire Canadian AI chip startup Taalas. The company focuses on AI inference chips, with accelerators that are not general-purpose designs, but rather tailored to a single AI model.

AMD relies on its GPUs to drive data center business growth, as cloud service providers continue to buy advanced AI chips. However, as the generative AI craze is about to enter its fourth year, the market is finding that GPUs are not applicable to all AI workloads.

Although Taalas' design sacrifices the chip's generality, the company claims that its technology can produce lower-cost chips and complete inference on specific models thousands of times faster than traditional GPUs.
An AMD spokesperson refused to disclose the transaction amount. Taalas has raised $2.19 billion in venture capital since its inception in 2023.
This acquisition comes just over seven months after NVIDIA (NVDA-US) spent $200 billion to acquire Groq's high-performance AI chip design assets. It is NVIDIA's largest acquisition to date.

Taalas' current chips can run Meta's (META-US) Llama 3.1 small version, and the company is developing chips that can support larger and more advanced models. Its chips are produced using TSMC's (TSM-US) older process and feature high-speed SRAM memory.

Taalas CEO Ljubisa Bajic said on the company's website, "We've built a platform that can convert any AI model into a custom silicon chip. From receiving a new model that's never been seen before, we can get it running on hardware in just two months."
Companies like Taalas and Groq are particularly important for "low-latency" applications, which prioritize the speed of the AI model's first response.

AMD CEO Lisa Su said at a product launch event in July, "I've always believed that there is no one-size-fits-all solution for chips." She also noted that AMD still expects GPUs to dominate the AI chip market, as GPUs are flexible enough to support new AI models.
GPU demand has propelled NVIDIA to become the world's most valuable company, with a market value of over $5 trillion.

This acquisition also reflects the leading GPU manufacturers' growing emphasis on providing integrated AI systems rather than just selling individual processors. AMD has recently begun shipping Helios to customers including Meta and Microsoft (MSFT-US), which is its first product to compete with NVIDIA's integrated AI server racks.
AMD said it will integrate Taalas' chips and technology into its product roadmap, incorporating them into systems including CPUs and Instinct GPUs.
In addition, AMD continues to lay out other AI accelerators. In July, the company announced a partnership with Cerebras, with plans to integrate its AI chips into systems later this year.

AMD has been actively acquiring companies to fill the gaps needed to build Helios. In 2024, AMD acquired Silo AI for $665 million and ZT Systems for $4.9 billion, which provided the technology foundation for its server-level products. Last year, AMD also acquired several small AI companies, including MK1, which focuses on inference software.

items.title: OpenAI宣布：免費用戶與ChatGPT文字互動不再受到限制
items.title_en: OpenAI Announces Removal of Interaction Limits for Free ChatGPT Users
paras: OpenAI 周四（6 日）宣布，隨著熱門人工智慧（AI）應用 ChatGPT 最新更新，免費用戶與聊天機器人的文字互動將不再受到限制。
免費用戶的默認模型也將更新為 GPT‑5.6 Luna。即便是 GPT-5.6 系列中的輕量版模型，Luna 的表現依然優於目前免費用戶的默認模型 GPT-5.5 Instant。
免費用戶以及每月 8 美元 Go 套餐訂閱者還可以使用新的「思考」按鈕，該按鈕旨在讓人工智慧花更多時間推理，從而回答更複雜的問題。
儘管文字聊天已經能做到「免費暢聊」，但文件上傳、圖片生成、語音對話等更加消耗算力的對話仍會受到限制。這些更新預期從下周開始發布。
OpenAI 的最新動向或許正在展示人們使用 AI 的最新趨勢——愈發聚焦於最強大模型在實際工作流中的推理產出，純粹聊天消耗的算力已經能「免費」。
上月底 OpenAI 宣布下調 GPT 5.6 家族中兩款模型的價格，其中 GPT-5.6 Luna 下調 80%，GPT-5.6 Terra 下調 20%。這兩款模型距離發布剛剛過去三周。
Luna 是 GPT-5.6 系列中速度最快、成本最低的版本，最新價格降至每百萬輸入詞元 0.20 美元，每百萬輸出詞元 1.20 美元，此前分別為 1 美元和 6 美元。
中階模型 Terra 的輸入詞元價格降至每百萬 2 美元，輸出詞元價格將降至每百萬 12 美元，此前分別為 2.50 美元和 15 美元。最強的 GPT-5.6 Sol 價格不變，每百萬詞元輸入和輸出價格分別為 5 美元和 30 美元。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Thursday (6th) that, following the latest update of the popular artificial intelligence (AI) application ChatGPT, free users will no longer have their text interactions with chatbots restricted.
Free users' default models will also be updated to GPT-5.6 Luna, which outperforms the current default model GPT-5.5 Instant, even in its lightweight version.
Free users and those subscribed to the $8 per month Go plan will also be able to use the new 'think' button, designed to allow AI to spend more time reasoning and answer more complex questions.
Although text chat has already reached 'free flow', file uploads, image generation, and voice conversations, which consume more computational power, will still be restricted.
These updates are expected to be released next week.

OpenAI's latest moves may be showcasing the latest trend in AI usage - a growing focus on the most powerful models' reasoning output in actual workflows, as the computational power consumed by pure chat has already become 'free'.
Last month, OpenAI announced a price cut for two models in the GPT 5.6 family, with GPT-5.6 Luna cut by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra cut by 20%. These two models were released just three weeks ago.

Luna is the fastest and lowest-cost version of the GPT-5.6 series, with the latest price reduced to $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens, down from $1 and $6 respectively.

items.title: 澤倫斯基：今年上半年盟友防空飛彈交付量僅去年三分之一
items.title_en: Zelensky: Allies' Air‑Defense Missile Deliveries in H1 2026 Only One‑Third of 2025
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周三（5 日）表示，盟友在 2026 年上半年向烏克蘭提供的防空飛彈數量僅為 2025 年的三分之一，而俄羅斯正尋求在冬季前大幅提高飛彈產量，這對烏克蘭構成了安全威脅。
北約（NATO）秘書長呂特表示，北約正在努力為烏克蘭提供其亟需的防空系統。歐洲首個「愛國者」飛彈生產設施預定 9 月在德國啟用。
近日烏克蘭和俄羅斯都加大對對方重要設施的打擊。澤倫斯基表示，俄羅斯周三襲擊烏克蘭首都，導致一家啤酒廠、一個倉庫和一個郵件分揀中心被摧毀，至少 17 人死亡，數十人受傷。
令人關注的是，當天烏克蘭未能攔截任何一枚俄羅斯飛彈，這可能表明烏克蘭的「愛國者」飛彈攔截器嚴重短缺，澤倫斯基希望美國可以提供更多這類彈藥，但伊朗戰爭難以結束，令這一請求成功的希望渺茫。
自烏克蘭戰爭爆發以來，烏克蘭一直缺乏美國製造的「愛國者」攔截飛彈，這種飛彈能夠攔截俄羅斯的彈道飛彈。但最近幾周，飛彈短缺問題尤為嚴重。澤倫斯基說，攔截飛彈短缺的主要原因是中東戰爭。
伊朗戰爭消耗了大量「愛國者」飛彈和其他攔截飛彈，攔截飛彈短缺問題變得更加嚴峻。一項分析估計，自伊朗戰爭開打以來，美國的「愛國者」飛彈庫存至少銳減 65%。
知情人士本周透露，美國軍方已耗盡關鍵飛彈防禦系統近 80% 攔截彈，五角大廈的彈藥儲備已降至危險低點，美軍在衝突中幾乎動用了所有高精度遠程地對空武器。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Wednesday (the 5th) that the number of air‑defence missiles allies will deliver to Ukraine in the first half of 2026 is only one‑third of what they supplied in the same period of 2025, while Russia is seeking to dramatically boost its missile production before winter, posing a security threat to Ukraine.

NATO Secretary‑General Jens Stoltenberg said the alliance is working hard to provide Ukraine with the air‑defence systems it urgently needs. Europe’s first Patriot missile production facility is slated to become operational in Germany in September.

In recent days both Ukraine and Russia have stepped up strikes on each other’s critical infrastructure. Zelensky said Russia attacked the Ukrainian capital on Wednesday, destroying a brewery, a warehouse and a mail‑sorting centre, killing at least 17 people and wounding dozens.

Of particular concern, Ukraine failed to intercept any Russian missile that day, suggesting a severe shortage of Patriot interceptors. Zelensky hopes the United States can supply more of these munitions, but the ongoing war in Iran makes the prospect of success dim.

Since the war began, Ukraine has lacked U.S.-made Patriot interceptors, which are capable of shooting down Russian ballistic missiles. In recent weeks the shortage has become acute, and Zelensky blamed the scarcity primarily on the Middle‑East war.

The war in Iran has consumed large numbers of Patriot and other interceptors, worsening the shortage. An analysis estimates that since the conflict started, U.S. Patriot missile stockpiles have been reduced by at least 65%.

Sources familiar with the matter said this week that the U.S. military has exhausted nearly 80% of the interceptors for its key missile‑defence systems, with Pentagon ammunition reserves falling to a dangerously low level, and the U.S. has nearly deployed all of its high‑precision long‑range ground‑to‑air weapons in the conflict.

items.title: 美國限制鎢廢料、黑粉出口，優先供應國內需求
items.title_en: US Restricts Export of Molybdenum Waste and Black Mass, Prioritizing Domestic Demand
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國商務部宣布，自8月27日起，黑粉(Black Mass)及鎢廢料出口都必須先取得政府許可，企業也要定期申報在美國國內的銷售情況。簡單來說，美國希望把這些關鍵原料留在國內，降低對海外供應的依賴，確保國防及重要產業的原料供應。
事實上，在新措施上路前，美國鎢廢料出口已明顯增加。根據美國普查局資料，2026年3月鎢廢料出口金額衝上3,291萬美元，創近年新高，4月至6月每月仍維持1,200萬美元以上，明顯高於2025年多數月份不到600萬美元的水準，反映海外需求快速增加，也成為美國收緊出口管制的背景之一。
這項措施由美國商務部工業暨安全局(BIS)公布，依據川普援引《國防生產法》(Defense Production Act)授權實施，目的是優先把關鍵礦物留在美國國內使用。
這也是川普政府近期推動關鍵礦物政策的一步。7月20日，美國已收緊向中國、俄羅斯、伊朗及北韓等國採購部分關鍵材料的豁免規定，希望降低對特定國家供應鏈的依賴。
其中，黑粉是廢棄鋰離子電池回收後的主要原料，含有鋰、鈷、鎳、錳等重要金屬，可再提煉製成電池材料，因此被視為重要的回收資源。
根據標普全球資料，美國2025年鎢廢料出口量達220萬公斤，年增率14.3%；黑粉出口量則達1億公斤，年增率48.7%，反映全球對電池回收材料的需求持續攀升。
這項臨時規定將實施一年。美國商務部也同步徵詢各界意見，評估是否需要進一步提高國內銷售要求，以持續強化關鍵礦物供應安全。
台廠方面，從事鎢與鈷回收的聯友金屬-創(7610-TW)目前以鎢酸鈉為主力產品，並持續擴產氧化鎢、鎢粉及碳化鎢等高附加價值材料。
隨著美國限制鎢廢料出口，全球可流通的回收原料可能減少，各國也將加快建立自己的鎢回收與加工能力。包括三菱材料在內的國際業者已開始擴充歐洲鎢回收產能，顯示非中國供應鏈正加速發展。
不過，若全球原料供應同步趨緊，也可能推升採購成本，實際受惠程度仍需觀察原料來源及新產能投產進度。

paras_en: August 7, 2026 (Optimal Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) - The US Department of Commerce announced that, starting from August 27, exports of Black Mass and molybdenum waste must first obtain government permits, and companies must also report their sales situation in the US on a regular basis. In simple terms, the US hopes to keep these critical raw materials at home, reduce dependence on overseas supplies, and ensure the supply of raw materials for national defense and important industries.

In fact, before the new measures took effect, US molybdenum waste exports had increased significantly. According to data from the US Census Bureau, molybdenum waste exports reached $32.91 million in March 2026, a new high in recent years, and remained above $12 million per month from April to June, significantly higher than the average of less than $6 million per month in 2025, reflecting rapid growth in overseas demand, which has become one of the background factors for the US to tighten export controls.

This measure was announced by the US Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), which is authorized by President Trump to implement under the Defense Production Act, with the goal of prioritizing the use of critical minerals in the US.

This is also a step in the recent key mineral policy promoted by the Trump administration. On July 20, the US tightened the exemption regulations for purchasing certain key materials from China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea, hoping to reduce dependence on specific countries' supply chains.

Among them, Black Mass is the main raw material recovered from discarded lithium-ion batteries, containing lithium, cobalt, nickel, and manganese, which can be further refined and manufactured into battery materials, making it an important recyclable resource.

According to data from S&P Global, US molybdenum waste exports reached 220,000 kg in 2025, with a year-on-year growth rate of 14.3%, while Black Mass exports reached 1 billion kg, with a year-on-year growth rate of 48.7%, reflecting the continued growth in global demand for battery recycling materials.

This temporary regulation will be implemented for one year. The US Department of Commerce will also solicit opinions from all parties and evaluate whether to further increase domestic sales requirements to continue strengthening the security of critical mineral supplies.

Taiwanese companies, such as Lianyou Metal-Creat (7610-TW), which specializes in the recovery of molybdenum and cobalt, currently focus on molybdenum sodium as their main product and continue to expand production of oxidized molybdenum, molybdenum powder, and carbonized molybdenum, among other high-value-added materials.

As the US restricts molybdenum waste exports, the global supply of recyclable raw materials may decrease, and countries will accelerate the establishment of their own molybdenum recycling and processing capabilities. International companies, including Mitsubishi Materials, have begun to expand their molybdenum recycling capacity in Europe, indicating that non-China supply chains are accelerating development.

However, if global raw material supplies become tight simultaneously, it may also push up procurement costs, and the actual benefits will need to be observed in the progress of new production capacity and the source of raw materials.

items.title: 歐洲熱浪衝擊供應鏈與通膨，空調、避險需求同步升溫
items.title_en: European Heatwave Impacts Supply Chain and Inflation, Air Conditioning and Risk Management Demand Rise
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 歐洲今年夏天持續出現破紀錄高溫，影響已不只是民眾生活，更開始衝擊物流、農業、物價及企業營運。對投資市場來說，熱浪正從天氣事件變成影響經濟的重要因素。
首先受到影響的是物流運輸。由於萊茵河水位持續下降，部分貨船無法滿載，甚至暫停航行，導致運輸成本增加。萊茵河是德國最重要的內河航道，每年運送約2.85億公噸貨物，一旦運輸受阻，化工、鋼鐵等製造業都可能受到影響。
高溫也讓農作物生長受到衝擊。乾旱與野火可能降低收成，進一步推高食品價格。如果能源價格再度上漲，食品和能源成本一起增加，將讓通膨壓力進一步升高，也讓歐洲央行在控制物價與支撐經濟之間面臨更大挑戰。
根據德國曼海姆大學與歐洲央行研究，熱浪、乾旱及洪水已使歐洲去年經濟產出減少約0.3%，若極端氣候持續，到2029年累積影響可能擴大至0.8%。
除了風險，也有新的商機浮現。隨著高溫成為常態，企業開始購買更多天氣避險工具，巨災債券基金規模持續成長，歐洲天氣期貨交易量今年也增加近30%，反映企業希望降低極端天氣帶來的營運風險。
消費市場同樣受惠。歐洲民眾對空調與風扇需求快速增加，零售商Currys(CURY-GB)及家樂福Carrefour(CA-FR)都表示，降溫產品銷售明顯成長。義大利家電廠De'Longhi(DLG-IT)也指出，空調與降溫設備銷售成長速度已超過咖啡機等主要產品。
歐盟預估，到2030年，歐盟家用空調數量將超過1億台，高於2020年的5,700萬台，顯示降溫設備市場仍有很大的成長空間。
整體來看，歐洲熱浪不只是短期天氣現象，而是逐漸改變供應鏈、物價和消費需求。對企業而言，物流、農業及保險成本可能持續增加；對空調、冷卻設備及相關供應鏈來說，則有望迎來長期商機。
